voiceScript: The next emergency call from someone you love might not be their real voice. Deepfake Voices means synthetic speech made to sound like a real person, sometimes built from short public audio clips. Picture this: a parent hears a call that sounds like their child urgently asking for money. Here is why that matters: familiar sound is no longer proof of identity when a caller creates panic. Hang up and call the person on a trusted number. Use a private family verification phrase. Click the Follow button to see new cybersecurity tips every day.
